profile.photoGuideLink: How should I take the photo?
profile.photoGuideIntro: Virtual try-on puts the item you pick on top of the clothes in your photo. That means what you're wearing in the shot directly shapes the result: photographed in something baggy, a slim item can come out looking wide.
profile.guideDoFull: Stand full body — head to feet inside the frame.
profile.guideDoPose: Face the camera straight on, standing upright, arms relaxed at your sides.
profile.guideDoPlain: Shoot against a plain, single-color wall.
profile.guideDoFitted: Wear something fitted — leggings or a close-cut tee.
profile.guideDontBaggy: No baggy, oversize or layered clothing — the old garment's outline bleeds into the result.
profile.guideDontBusy: Keep out busy backgrounds, other people in frame, and mirror reflections.
profile.guideDontAngle: Don't shoot from the side, above or below — extreme angles distort the proportions.
profile.guideDontDark: Don't shoot in dim light or harsh shadow.
profile.changeStyleConfirm: You'll retake the style quiz. Your current style profile will be updated.
profile.photoIntro: See outfits on yourself: virtual try-on uses this photo.

upload.photoGuideLink: How should I take the photo?
upload.photoGuideIntro: We remove the background automatically and read the color and pattern from the photo too. A clean shot means the item is recognized correctly and looks right in your outfits.
upload.guideDoFlat: Lay the item flat and smooth out the wrinkles.
upload.guideDoPlain: Use a plain, single-color surface that contrasts with the item.
upload.guideDoLight: Shoot in natural light, straight down from above.
upload.guideDontCrumpled: Don't shoot it crumpled or folded.
upload.guideDontOverlap: Don't stack items or fit more than one garment in the frame.
upload.guideDontDark: Don't shoot in dim light or harsh shadow.
upload.guideDontCrop: Don't crop the edges — keep the whole item in frame.
upload.manualNote: Because you haven't given AI permission, photos are saved as they are and you choose the category, colour and season yourself.
upload.guideDoLegs: Pants, shorts, jumpsuits: legs apart and fully extended, waistband visible
upload.guideDontFolded: Folded legs — may be mistaken for shorts or a top
upload.photoTip: Tip: Lay the item flat so the whole piece is visible.

consent.title: Virtual try-on
consent.intro: We only process personal details for virtual try-on with your explicit consent. Please read the notice below first.
consent.whatBody: Your full-length photo, if you upload one; your physical details, if you fill them in (height, weight, age, body type, skin tone, hair colour, length and type).
consent.whyBody: Only for virtual try-on: to dress your clothes on your photo or on an AI mannequin generated from your physical details. They are not used for outfit suggestions.
consent.whoBody: The try-on image is created by the image-generation service FASHN. Your photo is sent to FASHN via a link valid for 10 minutes; your physical details are sent as a description for generating an AI mannequin. Your own photo and physical details are not sent to Anthropic or Poof.
consent.controlBody: This data is kept in your account for as long as your consent lasts. You can withdraw each consent separately in Profile → Privacy & permissions; the data tied to that consent and the images created with it are deleted.
consent.rightsBody: You can access your data and ask for it to be corrected or deleted. Use Profile → Download my data to get a copy, or Delete My Account to delete all of it.
consent.readFirst: To give consent, first read the notice and tap “I've read this”.
consent.explicitIntroOne: This step needs the consent below.
consent.explicitIntroMany: The two consents are independent; you can agree to just one of them.
consent.photoCheckbox: I give my explicit consent to my full-length photo being sent to FASHN so clothes can be tried on me.
consent.physicalCheckbox: I give my explicit consent to my physical details being sent to FASHN to generate an AI mannequin that resembles me.
consent.saveError: Couldn't save your consent. Check your connection and try again.
consent.existingIntro: We now ask for virtual try-on consents separately. Please give the consents needed for the details you saved earlier; details tied to a consent you don't give will be deleted, and you can keep using the app.
consent.decline: I don't agree to any (delete my data)

aiConsent.title: Can we process your photos with AI?
aiConsent.intro: When you add clothes and use “Match?” scans, we send your photo to two service providers. We ask for your permission before sending anything.
aiConsent.whatBody: Only the photo of the clothing item you add or the product you scan. If you allow this, the names of the styles you pick are also sent to Anthropic to create your Style DNA name. Your own photo, physical details, name and email address are not sent.
aiConsent.anthropicPurpose: To recognise the item's features such as category, colour, pattern and season.
aiConsent.trainingBody: According to the providers, the photos we send are not used to train their AI models.
aiConsent.declineBody: You can keep using the app. Clothing photos are saved as they are (background not removed), and you choose the category, colour and season yourself. “Match?” scans stay off. You can change your choice at any time in Profile → Privacy & permissions.

privacy.title: Privacy & permissions
privacy.intro: You can give or withdraw each permission separately. The status shows your most recent choice.
privacy.aiBody: Your clothing and product photos are sent to Poof (Germany) for background removal and to Anthropic (USA) for feature recognition.
privacy.aiWithdrawEffect: If you withdraw it, your existing clothes and their details are not deleted. New clothes are saved with the photo as it is, and you choose the category, colour and season. “Match?” scans turn off.
privacy.photoBody: Your full-length photo is sent to FASHN so clothes can be tried on you.
privacy.photoWithdrawEffect: If you withdraw it, your photo and the try-on images created with it are deleted. Your physical details and AI mannequin stay.
privacy.physicalBody: Your physical details are sent to FASHN to generate an AI mannequin that resembles you.
privacy.physicalWithdrawEffect: If you withdraw it, your physical details, the AI mannequin generated from them and the try-on images created with the mannequin are deleted. Your photo stays.
privacy.textUpdatedMajor: The text you agreed to has changed; please give this permission again.
privacy.textUpdatedMinor: The text you agreed to has had minor updates; your permission still applies.
